TECHNICAL
WHAT: When Pixel Office has no browser clients connected, PreToolUse hook should fall through to Claude Code's native approval system instead of blocking forever.
WHERE: src/app/api/hooks/pre-tool-use/route.ts + src/lib/ws-server.ts
HOW:
```typescript
// ws-server.ts
export function hasClients(): boolean {
  const wss = (globalThis as any).__wss as WebSocketServer | undefined
  if (!wss) return false
  return wss.clients.size > 0
}

// pre-tool-use/route.ts
import { hasClients } from '@/lib/ws-server'

if (needsApproval && !hasClients()) {
  return new NextResponse(null, { status: 204 }) // fall through to Claude Code terminal
}
```
WHY: If browser is closed, you still want Claude Code to work — it falls back to its own permission dialog in the terminal rather than blocking forever waiting for a browser that will never respond.
GOTCHA: Auto-approved commands should still return explicit allow regardless of whether clients are connected.
